title: ClusterVAD: Threshold-Free Unsupervised Voice Activity Detection with Pre-Trained Neural Representations
summary: Voice activity detection (VAD) is one of the first steps in speech processing pipelines, from transcription and diarization to speech language models. Supervised detectors need labelled data and inherit the domain and annotation conventions of their training corpora. Existing unsupervised detectors rely on hand-crafted acoustic features which cannot benefit from data and degrade in far-field, noisy or atypical speech. We propose ClusterVAD, an unsupervised VAD built on frozen speech foundation model representations. Fitted once on a small set of untranscribed speech, it clusters the representations and labels each cluster as speech or non-speech with sonority, an acoustic measure. At inference, a frame-level speech probability is computed from the cluster assignments, and a two-state hidden Markov model fitted to each recording enables threshold-free detection. Across benchmarks covering meetings, far-field and noisy recordings, Mandarin and dysarthric speech, ClusterVAD obtains the lowest detection error on pause-level references and is competitive on speaker turn-level references. These results indicate that speech foundation models inherently capture the distinction between speech and non-speech, which can be leveraged without training a detector.

AI.tldr: ClusterVAD是一种无监督语音活动检测方法，利用冻结的语音基础模型表示进行聚类，并通过声学响度（sonority）标记聚类类别，无需标注数据即可实现高精度VAD。
AI.motivation: 现有监督VAD依赖标注数据且受限于领域和标注规范；无监督VAD依赖手工声学特征，无法从数据中学习，且在远场、噪声或非典型语音场景下性能下降。
AI.method: 基于冻结的语音基础模型表示进行聚类，利用声学响度（sonority）将每个聚类标记为语音或非语音；推理时计算帧级语音概率，并通过两状态隐马尔可夫模型实现无阈值检测。
AI.result: 在多个基准（会议、远场、噪声、普通话、构音障碍语音）上，在暂停级参考上取得最低检测错误率，在说话人轮次级参考上具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 语音基础模型内在地捕捉了语音与非语音的区别，无需训练检测器即可利用这一特性。

title: Mask-Based Speech Enhancement for Spatial Audio: Effects of Signal Representation and Channel-Specific Masking
summary: Speech enhancement for spatial audio needs to improve speech quality and intelligibility while preserving the spatial characteristics of the acoustic scene. Time-frequency masking provides an effective approach for speech enhancement, but its performance and spatial fidelity may depend strongly on the signal representation in which the mask is applied. This work systematically compares time-frequency masking in the microphone, beamformer, and first-order Ambisonics domains in simulated reverberant acoustic scenes. Both an ideal ratio mask (IRM) and a lightweight deep-learning-based mask estimator are considered, with performance evaluated in terms of speech reconstruction, perceptual quality, intelligibility, reverberation preservation, and binaural spatial-cue preservation. The results show that channel-specific masking in the beamformer domain provides the highest speech quality and intelligibility, while channel-specific masking in the Ambisonics domain better preserves the spatial characteristics of the residual interference. Reducing the spatial representation from third- to first-order Ambisonics substantially reduces the performance gap between the beamformer and Ambisonics domains due to the lower spatial resolution of the resulting beamformers. Furthermore, a shared mask across first-order Ambisonics channels achieves speech enhancement performance close to that of channel-specific masking while requiring only a single mask-estimation network. These results demonstrate that the choice of signal representation and masking strategy should be considered jointly, and indicate that first-order Ambisonics with shared masking provides a practical compromise between speech enhancement performance, spatial fidelity, and computational complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了麦克风、波束成形器和一阶Ambisonics三种信号域中的时频掩蔽策略，发现波束成形器域通道特定掩蔽提供最佳语音质量和可懂度，而Ambisonics域掩蔽能更好保留残余干扰的空间特征；一阶Ambisonics配合共享掩蔽在性能、空间保真度和计算复杂度之间提供了实用权衡。
AI.motivation: 空间音频的语音增强需要在提升语音质量和可懂度的同时保留声场的空间特征，而掩蔽性能与信号表示域的选择密切相关，目前缺乏对多种域的系统比较。
AI.method: 在模拟混响声学场景中，分别在麦克风、波束成形器和一阶Ambisonics域应用时频掩蔽，对比理想比例掩蔽和轻量深度学习掩蔽估计器，评估语音重建、感知质量、可懂度、混响保留和双耳空间线索保留。
AI.result: 波束成形器域通道特定掩蔽获得最高语音质量和可懂度；Ambisonics域通道特定掩蔽更好保留残余干扰的空间特征；空间阶数从三阶降至一阶时，波束成形器与Ambisonics域的性能差距显著缩小；一阶Ambisonics共享掩蔽的性能接近通道特定掩蔽。
AI.conclusion: 信号表示域和掩蔽策略应联合考虑，一阶Ambisonics配合共享掩蔽是兼顾语音增强性能、空间保真度和计算复杂度的实用折中方案。

title: Perfect Scores, Misplaced Explanations: A Controlled Study of Explainability in Audio Deepfake Detection
comment: Submitted to ICASSP worshop on Explainability, Robustness, and Controllability of Language Modeling for Speech and Audio
summary: What if an explanation achieves perfect scores but it is uninterpretable? We show that this happens when explaining audio deepfake detectors. Using an optimization-based method, we explain a state-of-the-art wav2vec2-based detector. The explanations achieve optimal scores on standard explainability metrics, i.e. fidelity and faithfulness. Visual inspection, however, reveals unintuitive and uninterpretable patterns. To understand this discrepancy, we run a controlled perturbation study in which we modify known frequency regions of the speech signal. Although we propose a model that is able to obtain close-to-optimal results with respect to the metrics, the explanations locate the manipulated region only when it is fixed across samples, and mostly fall to chance level when it varies. We further show that the signal used to fill the removed regions largely determines the explanation and its localization, without being reflected in the metrics.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现：当使用基于优化的方法解释音频深度伪造检测器时，即使解释在保真度和忠实度等标准可解释性指标上达到最优，仍可能是不可解释的。受控扰动实验表明，这类解释仅在操纵区域固定不变时才能准确定位，当操纵区域变化时效果接近随机水平；填充信号的类型也显著影响解释结果但不会被指标反映。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性指标（保真度、忠实度）无法反映解释的实际可理解性，在音频深度伪造检测这一关键安全应用领域，指标优异的解释可能完全不可解释，这威胁到模型的可信度与安全性。
AI.method: 采用基于优化的方法对基于wav2vec2的SOTA深度伪造检测器进行解释；通过受控扰动实验，修改语音信号的已知频域区域，系统考察解释在不同操纵条件（固定区域 vs 变化区域）下的定位能力，并分析填充信号类型对解释的影响。
AI.result: 解释在保真度和忠实度指标上达到最优，但视觉检查显示模式不可解释；受控实验表明，仅当操纵区域固定时解释才能定位，区域变化时接近随机水平；填充信号类型主导了解释结果与定位，但指标无法反映这一缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 标准可解释性指标（保真度、忠实度）不足以评估解释的实际质量，在音频深度伪造检测等任务中，仅依赖这些指标可能产生看似优秀但实际上不可靠的解释，亟需更有效的评估方法。

title: Reproducing the Speech Labels of Qwen3-Omni's Talker: Mimi in bf16, and a Last-Frame Pitfall
summary: Qwen3-Omni speaks through a Talker predicting 16 codebooks of a 12.5 Hz audio codec, but the encoder that made its training labels was not released, so new voices cannot be trained on matching labels. We identify this encoder from the released model's behavior. White-box regression shows that the codebook embeddings of the Talker, its multi-token predictor and the Code2Wav decoder match the first 16 codebooks of kyutai's Mimi layer by layer. A decoder-based test looks convincing but fails calibration: decoders trained on known labels cannot tell them apart. Teacher-forced Talker likelihoods, calibrated with 13 code language models trained on known labels, do tell implementations apart: the Talker prefers labels from kyutai's moshi package with bf16 weights over every other variant we tried. Loudness normalization and band-limiting of 20% or more of the data are ruled out. Separately, transformers' MimiModel encodes the last frame differently from kyutai's encoder unless the input length is a multiple of 1920 samples. After LoRA fine-tuning on its labels, 44--55% of generated sentences end in a noise burst, and the same frame costs the Mimi-based CSM-1B 119 nats; padding the input removes both. We release the encoding recipe, a label checker and a Talker fine-tuning toolkit.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过对模型行为的逆向分析和实验验证，识别出Qwen3-Omni语音生成模块所使用的音频编码器为kyutai的Mimi编码器，并揭示了其编码特性（如末帧异常、输入长度约束等），同时发布了编码配方和微调工具包。
AI.motivation: Qwen3-Omni的语音生成模块（Talker）使用16个码本的音频编解码器，但其训练标签的编码器未公开，导致无法在新语音数据上生成匹配标签进行训练。作者希望通过逆向分析已发布模型的行为来识别该编码器。
AI.method: 采用白盒回归分析（验证码本嵌入、多token预测器、解码器与Mimi编码器的逐层匹配）、解码器校准测试、教师强制似然校准（基于13个码语言模型）、输入长度影响实验及LoRA微调验证。
AI.result: 识别出编码器为kyutai的Mimi（基于moshi包，使用bf16权重）；发现当输入长度不是1920的整数倍时，编码器的末帧处理存在差异；LoRA微调后44-55%的生成句子以噪声突发结尾，该问题可通过填充输入解决。
AI.conclusion: 成功解析出Qwen3-Omni使用的编码器，揭示了其末帧编码缺陷，并提供了避免该问题的输入填充方法，同时发布了编码配方、标签检查器和Talker微调工具包以推动复现和改进。

title: IncrementDET: Continual AI-Generated Music Detection via Enrollment
summary: AI-generated music has become common on music streaming platforms, and listeners often cannot distinguish it from music made by humans. AI-music detection is therefore needed, but detectors trained on a fixed set of generators often fail on unseen generators. As new generators emerge frequently, updating a universal detector, a single model for all generators, typically requires substantial training data and computation, while risking performance degradation on previously learned generators. We therefore introduce IncrementDET, a detector that learns each new generator by a process called enrollment. For each generator, IncrementDET trains one linear classifier, which we call a needle, to separate samples of that generator from a fixed set of human reference tracks. Enrolling a new generator adds one needle while the previously constructed needles remain unchanged. A Sidak correction keeps the overall false-positive rate at its target as needles are added. To compare detectors under these conditions, we define the task of continual AI-generated music detection and introduce a benchmark in which generators arrive one at a time. The benchmark measures the accuracy of a detector before and after each update and the cost of each update. For this benchmark, we also construct EvoMusicFake-17K, a dataset of instrumental music from six recent generators and four human music platforms. Compared with SpecTTTra, a state-of-the-art universal detector, IncrementDET learns a new generator more accurately from only a few samples, generalizes better to unseen generators and better preserves detection performance on previously learned generators, at a substantially lower update cost. The structure of IncrementDET can also be applied to the detection of generated images and video, where new generators are released just as frequently.

AI.tldr: 提出增量检测器IncrementDET，通过为每个新生成器训练一个线性分类器（针）来实现持续学习的AI音乐检测，在保持低假阳性率的同时，比通用检测器更高效、准确。
AI.motivation: 现有AI音乐检测器在固定生成器集上训练后，对未见生成器泛化差；新生成器频繁出现时，更新通用检测器需要大量数据和计算，且可能损害已学性能。
AI.method: 针对每个新生成器，训练一个线性分类器（称为针）来区分该生成器样本与固定的人类参考音轨；新增针时不改变已有针；采用Sidak校正控制整体假阳性率。
AI.result: 在EvoMusicFake-17K数据集上，相比通用检测器SpecTTTra，IncrementDET用更少样本学习新生成器更准确，对未见生成器泛化更好，更好保持已学生成器性能，且更新成本显著降低。
AI.conclusion: IncrementDET为持续AI音乐检测提供了有效方案，且其结构可推广到图像和视频生成检测。

title: Cif-query bridging for audio-native asr transfer to visual speech recognition
summary: Audio-native automatic speech recognition (ASR) models provide strong speech-language priors, but their compact acoustic interfaces are mismatched with long, frame-level visual features. We propose CIF-Query Bridge, a lightweight connection from a Paraformer visual speech recognition (VSR) encoder to Qwen3-ASR. The existing visual continuous integrate-and-fire (CIF) predictor produces an input-dependent number of token-rate queries; a two-layer cross-attention bridge refines them against the complete frame sequence, and a linear adapter feeds the pretrained ASR projector and decoder. This design preserves access to uncompressed visual context while avoiding direct autoregressive processing of hundreds of video frames. On CMLR, the complete visual-only transfer system achieves 7.97% character error rate, compared with 11.78% for native Paraformer under the same test split and scoring protocol---a 3.81-point absolute and 32.3% relative reduction. Controlled ablations characterize bridge depth, projector initialization, adapter capacity, and CTC supervision. The results show that CIF-derived adaptive queries provide a compact interface for transferring audio-native ASR capability to VSR.

AI.tldr: 提出CIF-Query Bridge，将Paraformer视觉语音识别（VSR）编码器连接到Qwen3-ASR模型。通过视觉CIF预测器生成自适应查询令牌，经两层交叉注意力桥与完整帧序列交互后，由线性适配器馈入预训练ASR投影器和解码器。在CMLR上视觉仅传输系统达到7.97%字符错误率，相比原生Paraformer的11.78%降低32.3%。
AI.motivation: 音频原生ASR模型具有强大的语音-语言先验，但其紧凑的声学接口与长序列的帧级视觉特征不匹配，需要一种轻量连接方式将ASR能力迁移至VSR。
AI.method: 使用视觉CIF预测器生成输入依赖数量的令牌级查询；通过两层交叉注意力桥对查询与完整帧序列进行精炼；采用线性适配器将精炼后的查询馈入预训练ASR投影器和解码器。
AI.result: CMLR上CIF-Query Bridge达到7.97% CER，相比Paraformer原生VSR的11.78% CER绝对降低3.81点，相对降低32.3%。
AI.conclusion: CIF衍生的自适应查询提供了一种紧凑接口，有效将音频原生ASR能力迁移至视觉语音识别。

title: Lossless Re-Encoding of Vorbis and Opus Audio Files
summary: We present Balrogg, a lossless recompressor that replaces the entropy coding of Ogg Vorbis and Ogg Opus files with adaptive context mixing models. For Vorbis, we write each represent each codebook entry as a tuple of small signed integers (digits), binarized in five stages, and mixed with a direct context model, a bit-history model, and a match model, with weights selected by the neighboring digits and the previous residue pass. For Opus, each symbol is coded by an adaptive context model initialized with the codec's probability tables as priors, and the pyramid vector quantizer (PVQ) indices of the CELT layer are split recursively into pulse counts. At the default level, Balrogg reduces Vorbis music by 16.2\%, Vorbis speech by 10.6%, and Opus speech by 5.4%; xz, zstd, ZPAQ, and bzip3 save at most 4.1% on the same files. Over 48 encoder configurations, files shrink to 66.5--96.1% of their size. Encoding and decoding are symmetric, run at 1.8--3.2~MB/s per core, and use less than 12~MiB of memory.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Balrogg的无损重压缩器，通过自适应上下文混合模型替换Ogg Vorbis和Ogg Opus文件的熵编码，在Vorbis音乐、Vorbis语音和Opus语音上分别实现了16.2%、10.6%和5.4%的压缩率提升，远超xz等通用压缩器（最高4.1%），且编解码对称、速度快、内存占用低。
AI.motivation: 现存通用压缩器（如xz、zstd等）对Ogg Vorbis和Opus音频文件的压缩率有限（最高仅4.1%），亟需针对音频编解码器内部结构设计的专用重压缩方案来进一步提升压缩效率。
AI.method: 针对Vorbis：将每个码本条目表示为小有符号整数元组，经五阶段二值化后，结合直接上下文模型、比特历史模型和匹配模型进行混合，权重由相邻数字和残差通道选择；针对Opus：每个符号由以编解码器概率表为先验的自适应上下文模型编码，CELT层的PVQ索引递归拆分为脉冲计数。
AI.result: 在默认级别下，Balrogg对Vorbis音乐压缩16.2%、Vorbis语音压缩10.6%、Opus语音压缩5.4%；而xz、zstd、ZPAQ和bzip3在相同文件上最多仅能压缩4.1%。在48种编码器配置下，文件可压缩至原大小的66.5%–96.1%。编解码对称，速度为1.8–3.2 MB/s/核，内存<12 MiB。
AI.conclusion: Balrogg通过针对Ogg Vorbis和Opus内部结构的自适应上下文建模，在无损重压缩任务上显著超越通用压缩器，兼具高压缩率、对称编解码速度和低内存占用等优势。

title: VividAudio: Multi-Event Reference-Conditioned Video-to-Audio Generation
summary: Existing video-to-audio (V2A) methods have achieved promising results in synthesizing high-quality audios. However, as V2A advances toward more flexible user-directed creation, existing methods remain notably limited in controlling the distinct acoustic identities of multiple events within a video. We therefore formulate multi-event reference-conditioned V2A (Mr-V2A), where each event is assigned a specific audio reference and target time span. Mr-V2A presents three key challenges. First, event-level reference-target training pairs are scarce. We introduce Intra-Video Event Variation (IntraEvtVar), which constructs non-oracle pairs through four variation modes of events mined within each video. Second, we organize the references into a Time-Aligned COmposite Reference (TACO-Ref) and inject it through local and global pathways: the local pathway retains time-resolved event cues, while an Audio Q-Former provides a clip-level acoustic-context condition. Third, jointly conditioning on multiple references can cause acoustic-attribute leakage across events. Localized reference attention and the TACO-Ref Router (TRR) explicitly constrain event-to-reference correspondence to reduce such interference. Experiments on VGGSound-Ref and VividBench demonstrate stronger reference controllability than existing V2A and exemplar-based methods while maintaining competitive Foley generation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多事件参考条件视频到音频合成框架Mr-V2A，通过IntraEvtVar构建训练对、TACO-Ref组织多参考信息、局部参考注意力与TRR路由机制解决事件间声学属性泄露，在保持生成质量的同时实现更强的事件级参考控制。
AI.motivation: 现有V2A方法在用户导向的灵活创建中，无法有效控制视频中多个事件的独立声学身份。
AI.method: 提出Mr-V2A框架，包含：(1) IntraEvtVar通过四种变异模式构建事件级参考-目标训练对；(2) TACO-Ref通过局部路径保持时间分辨线索、Audio Q-Former提供片段级声学上下文；(3) 局部参考注意力与TACO-Ref路由器(TRR)约束事件-参考对应关系以减少声学属性泄露。
AI.result: 在VGGSound-Ref和VividBench上，相比现有V2A和基于示例的方法，实现了更强的参考可控性，同时保持了有竞争力的Foley生成质量。
AI.conclusion: Mr-V2A有效解决了多事件视频到音频合成中的参考控制难题，通过事件级参考条件实现了灵活的用户导向音频生成。

title: Do Layer Rankings Survive Silence Trimming? The Silence Shortcut in Frozen WavLM Representations for Audio Deepfake Detection
comment: 36 pages, 9 figures, 14 tables. Code and result tables: https://github.com/Nooralabd/silence-shortcut-wavlm-layers
summary: Layer-wise analyses of frozen self-supervised encoders are used to locate spoofing information in audio deepfake detection. On the ASVspoof 2019 logical access (LA) benchmark, bonafide recordings carry longer leading and trailing silence than spoofed ones, and detectors exploit this cue, the silence shortcut. This paper examines whether layer rankings for a frozen WavLM Base encoder survive the trimming of this silence. A small classifier is trained on each of the 12 layers with and without trimming and evaluated on ASVspoof 2019 LA and, zero-shot, on In-the-Wild, in all four train/test combinations, with speaker-level bootstrap intervals. Trimming at 40 dB raises the in-domain error at every layer and preserves the layer ranking only partly (Kendall's tau of 0.58 in domain, 0.73-0.76 on In-the-Wild). The best layer is unchanged at 40 dB, but on the evaluation set it moves from layer 5 to layer 6 at 15 dB and, with mean pooling, at 20 dB, thresholds at which trimming may also remove low-energy speech. At 40 dB, the equal error rate of a model trained with silence rises by 6.3-19.9 percentage points at every layer when only its test audio is trimmed. On In-the-Wild, the effect depends on the layer: at layers 3-5, trimming the test audio lowers the error only for models trained on trimmed audio, whereas at layers 6, 8, and 9 training on trimmed audio lowers it also on clean test audio. We quantify how zero padding alters WavLM features through group normalization, an effect that an attention mask does not fully undo.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在使用冻结的自监督编码器（WavLM Base）进行音频深度伪造检测时，去除静音（silence trimming）如何影响各层的防伪能力。结果表明，40dB截断会提升域内错误率并仅部分保留层排名；更激进的截断可能改变最佳层位置；静音训练对测试结果的提升依赖于层和截断条件；零填充会通过组归一化改变WavLM特征，注意力掩码无法完全消除此效应。
AI.motivation: 先前研究发现，在ASVspoof 2019 LA基准上，真实语音的前导/末尾静音比伪造语音更长，检测器会利用这一“静音捷径”。本文旨在探究当去除这一静音线索后，自监督编码器不同层的特征表示是否仍然有效定位欺骗信息，以及层排名是否稳定。
AI.method: 使用冻结的WavLM Base编码器的12层特征，每层训练一个简单分类器（含/不含静音截断），在ASVspoof 2019 LA（域内）和In-the-Wild（零样本）上以4种训练/测试组合进行评估，附说话人级bootstrap置信区间。分析了不同截断阈值（40dB, 15dB, 20dB）的影响，并量化了零填充通过组归一化对特征的影响。
AI.result: 40dB截断使域内错误率全面上升，层排名仅部分保留（Kendall tau域内0.58，域外0.73-0.76）。最佳层在40dB不变，但在15dB（评估集）或20dB（均值池化）时从第5层移至第6层。仅测试时静音截断使各层EER上升6.3-19.9个百分点。域外效果依赖层：3-5层仅截断训练音频才降低测试错误，而6、8、9层截断训练音频在干净测试上也有降低。
AI.conclusion: 静音截断显著影响层特征对欺骗信息编码的评估，层排名并非完全鲁棒；最佳层的选择依赖于截断阈值和池化方式；零填充对特征的影响不可忽视。研究者在使用自监督特征进行深伪检测时应审慎处理静音预处理。

title: MADlibs: Analyzing the Distribution of Generative Music
summary: What music can a text-to-music model actually make? The answer to this question has consequences for individual creators, communities, and musical culture more broadly. We introduce MADlibs, a framework to measure the expressive support of state-of-the-art music generators: the subset of musical behaviors they will actually produce across the space of prompts. We first develop strategies for generating musical prompts using natural language processing methods and existing caption corpora. Then, we use a set of MIR techniques to study the corresponding output spaces in terms of interpretable and qualitatively meaningful elements like key, beat, tempo, instrumentation, and dynamics. We find that text-to-music models are not interchangeable instruments for the same prompt space. Rather, each model has learned idiosyncratic properties that constrain the regime of music reachable via prompting it, for example, defaulting to certain tempi, failing to produce silences, or oversampling canonical band arrangements. Because users interact with these systems one prompt at a time, these biases are often invisible in practice yet cumulatively shape what AI-assisted music sounds like, risking the production of a new auditory monoculture hidden behind the promise of universal describability. We thus urge the MIR community to further study and responsibly steer population-level properties of music generation models.

AI.tldr: 提出MADlibs框架，系统评估文本到音乐模型在实际提示空间中的表达支持范围，发现不同模型存在固有偏差（如默认速度、缺乏休止、过度采样标准乐队编排），可能导致听觉单一文化。
AI.motivation: 文本到音乐模型的输出行为存在潜在偏差，但缺乏系统性评估方法；这些偏差虽在单次交互中不可见，却会累积影响AI辅助音乐的多样性，威胁音乐文化的丰富性。
AI.method: 1. 利用自然语言处理方法和现有描述语料库生成音乐提示；2. 应用MIR技术（调性、节拍、速度、配器、力度等）分析模型输出空间的可解释音乐特征。
AI.result: 发现不同文本到音乐模型不是可互换的乐器，每个模型都学到了独特约束（如特定默认速度、无法生成休止、过度使用标准乐队编排），且这些偏差在单次提示中不可见。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁MIR社区进一步研究并负责任地引导音乐生成模型的种群级属性，避免在“通用可描述性”承诺下产生新的听觉单一文化。
